تجترمون (form VIII)
# تَجْتَرِمُونَ (tajtarimūna) /tad͡ʒ.ta.ri.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# تُجْتَرَمُونَ (tujtaramūna) /tud͡ʒ.ta.ra.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
